name: kamal-lint
description: Static config linter for secrets, registry mismatches, invalid roles, and legacy proxy settings.
details: Checks deploy.yml and destination overrides, and supports GitHub Actions annotations and structured output.
best_for: You want config failures caught before an actual production deploy.
caveat: Static linting cannot prove that servers and running workloads are healthy.

name: kamal-json-schema
description: Kamal 2 YAML schema providing editor autocomplete, hints, and validation.
details: A JSON Schema reference that can be attached to deploy.yml through a YAML language-server comment.
best_for: You want editor help while writing deployment configuration.
caveat: Editor checks complement Kamal's own config validation.
